title: 5 Investing Rules You Won’t See in Financial Media | Dimensional
gist: A short teaser for Dimensional's Informed Investor podcast Episode 53 argues that financial markets aren't predictable and that investors should rely on diversification as protective 'armor' rather than chasing financial-media forecasts; the underlying record carries almost no substantive content beyond this teaser and podcast metadata.

themes.theme: Diversification as protection against market unpredictability

insights.claim: Dimensional's Informed Investor podcast argues that people want to believe the future of financial markets is predictable, but the evidence says that's unlikely.
insights.speaker: Featuring Mark Gochnour, Head of Global Client Services Group
insights.so_what: A standard behavioral-finance rationale for maintaining a diversified, buy-and-hold posture rather than trying to time markets based on media narratives.
insights.quote: People want to believe the future of financial markets is predictable, but the evidence says that’s unlikely.

insights.claim: The podcast frames diversification explicitly as 'armor' investors can put on themselves to protect against an unpredictable market future, rather than as a tool for maximizing returns.
insights.speaker: Featuring Mark Gochnour, Head of Global Client Services Group
insights.so_what: A quotable framing for client communications: diversification is positioned as self-protection against uncertainty, not as a return-maximization tactic.
insights.quote: putting on the armor of diversification.

source_meta.author: Featuring Mark Gochnour, Head of Global Client Services Group
